valor: In the Kiwnas Cxhab resguardo, a collectively owned Indigenous territory, the Nasa people share what the coca leaf means to their life. In the face of forced eradication, they defend their knowledge and their right to decide over their territory.
motivo: traducida de su española; verificada por otro agente
